name: asnkit-compiler
description: Compile ASN.1 to the .asni files asnkit loads, in the browser and Node.js

scripts.build: cargo build --locked --profile wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p asnkit-compiler-wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --no-typescript --out-dir pkg ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/asnkit_compiler_wasm.wasm
